# CleanFixHarish

CleanFixHarish is opening in stages as one local contact for home-service requests in Harish, Israel. It currently accepts requests in four CleanFix categories: handyman, cleaning, painting, and AC cleaning. A request is not a booking; scope, availability, price, assignment, and booking must be confirmed separately in writing.

Gardening is separate and is currently reviewed with one local gardener, subject to written scope and availability. A wider network for independent Harish businesses is a future phase and has not launched.
